title: 환경정책기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Application for and Certificate of Designation for the International Environmental Cooperation Center)
① The term "international environmental cooperation center application form as specified in Article 12-2, paragraph 4 of the 'Act on the Fundamental Principles of Environmental Policy' (hereinafter referred to as "the Act")" refers to the international environmental cooperation center application form in Form 1, as specified in the Act, excluding the portions of Article 12-2, paragraph 4. <Amended on 2025.10.1>
② The term "international environmental cooperation center certificate as specified in Article 12-2, paragraph 5 of the Act" refers to the international environmental cooperation center certificate in Form 2, as specified in the Act. <Amended on 2025.10.1>
